title: Punjab Ministers Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Repeal Act 2022

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Ministers Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Repeal Act 2022
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PLD 2023 Punjab Statutes 2
PLD 2023 Punjab Statutes 2
ACT II OF 2023
PUNJAB MINISTERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND
PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) (REPEAL) ACT, 2022
An Act to repeal the Punjab Ministers (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 2022
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary, 13th January, 2023]
No. PAP/Legis-3(106)/2022/91, dated 13.1.2023.---The Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and
Privileges) (Amendment) (Repeal) Bill, 2022, originally passed by the
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on the 18th day of October 2022, was sent to
the Governor of the Punjab for assent. The Governor returned the Bill for
reconsideration by the Assembly. The Provincial Assembly of the Punjab, after
reconsideration, again passed the Bill on the 5th day of December 2022 and the
same was against sent to the Governor on the same day. Since the Governor has
not assented to the Bill within the stipulated period of ten days, the same is
deemed to have been assented to in terms of clause (3) of Article 116 of the
Constitution and is published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the
Punjab.
WHEREAS, in the interest of Parliamentary
Supremacy, it is expedient to repeal the Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances
and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 2022, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
Be it enacted by the Provincial Assembly of the
Punjab as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be cited as the Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges)
(Amendment) (Repeal) Act, 2022.
(2) It shall
come into force at once.
